text.p: Norway on Wednesday appointed Ranveig Froeiland as Oil and Energy Minister, the Energy Ministry said.

The appointment comes two days after former Energy Minister Grete Faremo resigned amid a scandal over the national intelligence service's surveillance of a prominent left-wing politician when she was Justice Minister.
Froeiland, 51, has sat on the parliamentary committee for energy and environmental affairs since 1993.
She has been a member of parliament since 1985 as a representative for Fjell, near Bergen on the west coast of Norway.

Froeiland was a vocal supporter in the recent debate over the building of Norway's first gas-fired power stations at Kollsnes and Kaarstoe near her constituency, a spokeswoman for the Energy Ministry said.
